title: 矩阵键盘扫描
goal: 掌握行列扫描法：行线输出扫描、列线读取判断，理解 4×4=16 个键只需 8 根线的原理。
doc:
实验平台（虚实结合）：本课程实物实验采用 STC89C52RC 最小系统板（京东开发板）与 STM32F407 最小系统板（京东开发板）。 本虚拟仿真实验基于上述最小系统板构建，可灵活扩展外设（LED、按键、上拉电阻、蜂鸣器、矩阵键盘、数码管、LCD1602、串口适配器等），是实物实验的有益补充——虚实结合、线上线下实验类似但不完全重复。

实验原理

4×4 矩阵键盘：行线 R1~R4 接 P1.0~P1.3（输出），列线 C1~C4 接 P1.4~P1.7（输入）。 扫描法：逐行输出低电平，读列线——若某列为 0，则该列与当前行交叉的键被按下。

接线表

键盘单片机
R1~R4P1.0 ~ P1.3
C1~C4P1.4 ~ P1.7

实验步骤

  1. 编译下载后，用鼠标按住键盘上任意键
  2. 观察 P2 口 8 个 LED：显示键号 1~16 的二进制值
  3. 对照代码理解"行扫描→读列→算键号→等释放"四步

思考

1. P1 = ~(0x01 << r) 中取反的作用？
2. while ((P1 & 0xF0) != 0xF0) 在等什么？去掉会怎样？
goalEn: Row–column scanning: drive the rows, read the columns — why 16 keys need only 8 wires.
docEn:
Experiment platform (virtual–physical): the physical labs in this course use the STC89C52RC minimal system board (JD.com) and the STM32F407 minimal system board (JD.com). This virtual experiment is built on the same boards and can be extended with peripherals (LEDs, buttons, pull-up resistors, buzzer, matrix keypad, 7-segment displays, LCD1602, UART adapter, etc.) — a useful complement to the physical labs: similar but not identical.

Principle

4×4 matrix keypad: row lines R1–R4 to P1.0–P1.3 (outputs), column lines C1–C4 to P1.4–P1.7 (inputs). Scanning method: drive one row low at a time and read the columns — a 0 on a column means the key at that row/column crossing is pressed.

Wiring

KeypadMCU
R1–R4P1.0 ~ P1.3
C1–C4P1.4 ~ P1.7

Steps

  1. After flashing, hold any key on the keypad with the mouse
  2. Watch the 8 LEDs on port P2: they show the key number 1–16 in binary
  3. Follow the four steps in the code: scan row → read columns → compute key number → wait for release

Reflection

1. What does the inversion do in P1 = ~(0x01 << r)?
2. What is while ((P1 & 0xF0) != 0xF0) waiting for — and what happens if it is removed?
